Warehousing

Перемещение запасов

The formal process of moving inventory from one warehouse or storage location to another, with full traceability in WMS, inventory ledgers, and stock transfer documents.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Перемещение запасов?

In this glossary, Перемещение запасов refers to: The formal process of moving inventory from one warehouse or storage location to another, with full traceability in WMS, inventory ledgers, and stock transfer documents.

How is Перемещение запасов used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Запрос на перемещение запасов инициируется в WMS для перемещения товаров между двумя региональными складами, при этом все перемещения фиксируются для аудита."

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

The formal process of moving inventory from one warehouse or storage location to another, with full traceability in WMS, inventory ledgers, and stock transfer documents.

Operational example

A stock transfer request is initiated in the WMS to move goods between two regional warehouses, with all movements recorded for audit purposes.

Localized term
